meta.title: Day 21: Alex's Project Collaboration
meta.title_zh: 第 21 天：Alex 的项目协作

study_card.difficulty: 项目协作 · 词汇主线
study_card.main_practice: 先听故事 · 再跟读 · 最后替换成自己的经历
value_points: 当天 18 个词汇都进入 Alex 的故事
Git 工作区状态 × 租房和维修 × 修改或撤销提交
study_card.suggested_pace: 先猜大意 · 听读 2 遍 · 遮住中文复述 · 完成输出任务

segments.en: By day 21, Alex is helping with a growing project. Because the project is growing, Alex needs to explain each step to the team. Before the meeting, Alex reviews "working tree" and "staged change" and explains why each one matters. When a teammate asks for an update, Alex uses "The sink is leaking." and "The light isn't working." to keep the conversation clear. After the meeting, Alex updates the project with "amend a commit" and "revert a commit" and records the next action. The team understands the plan, and Alex has learned to connect vocabulary with real work.

segments.zh: 第 21 天，Alex 正在帮助完成一个不断扩大的项目。因为项目在成长，Alex 需要向团队解释每一步。开会前，Alex 复习工作树、已暂存改动，并说明它们为什么重要。当队友询问进展时，Alex 使用水槽漏水了。、灯不亮了。，让对话保持清楚。会议后，Alex 用修改最近提交、还原提交更新项目，并记录下一项行动。团队理解了计划，Alex 也学会了把词汇和真实工作联系起来。

hard.def: 工作树，当前检出的项目文件状态
已暂存改动，准备进入下一次提交的变化
修改最近提交，补充或更正最后一次提交
还原提交，用新提交抵消旧提交的改动

segments.en: By day 21, Alex is helping with a growing project. Because the project is growing, Alex needs to explain each step to the team. Before the meeting, Alex reviews "unstaged change" and "tracked file" and explains why each one matters. When a teammate asks for an update, Alex uses "Could someone repair it?" and "When can the technician come?" to keep the conversation clear. After the meeting, Alex updates the project with "reset a branch" and "discard changes" and records the next action. The team understands the plan, and Alex has learned to connect vocabulary with real work.

hard.def: 未暂存改动，尚未加入提交区的变化
已跟踪文件，Git 已经纳入版本管理的文件
维修人员什么时候能来？
重置分支，把分支指针移到另一提交
丢弃改动，放弃尚未保存的文件变化

Before the meeting, Alex reviews "untracked file" and "clean state" and explains why each one matters. After the meeting, Alex updates the project with "restore a file" and "force push" and records the next action. The team understands the plan, and Alex has learned to connect vocabulary with real work.

强制推送，用本地历史覆盖远程分支历史
